the package never reaches a client. Drawing it at L1/L1b would invent an edge; the L1 description carries the fact instead.

known_residuals: L2b reports 1 label needing a leader tick (tl -> en 'files · shell'). Four layer arrangements were tried; all report it. The label renders legibly with the tick.
L1 (95 wide) and L2 (106 wide) pan past a 77-column pane. The viewer caps zoom-out at 100%, so they pan rather than shrink. Labels and containers are exact at natural fit.
Render verification came from text and ANSI captures only: no Herdr server was running (server_not_running), so no pane capture exists.
All facts are read from the tarball and public repos. Nothing was executed against a live storage backend.
